sources.title: Agetor README
sources.locator: Features; Supported harnesses; Install; Pipelines; Command-line interface; Keep Agetor running; How it works; Configuration; Security model; Roadmap
sources.finding: Local-first kanban orchestrator (Electrobun macOS app on Apple Silicon plus agetor CLI/headless daemon) running Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, fx, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode in per-task git worktrees; pipelines of Agents; no account, no cloud relay, no telemetry; MIT.

sources.title: Agetor README: Security model
sources.finding: Agents run with your full user privileges and Agetor adds no sandbox; API binds to 127.0.0.1 with a per-launch random token; untrusted issue text is labelled; only network calls are update checks, configured git hosts and harness quota lookups.

sources.title: Agetor README: Roadmap
sources.finding: Roadmap lists Linux and Windows builds (targets configured, not built or tested), graduating experimental harnesses to stable, and more harnesses; no dates.

sources.title: Task lifecycle
sources.finding: POST /tasks creates a backlog row with worktree isolation by default and pins the base ref sha; startTask runs pre-flight checks (agent on PATH, minimum CLI version) then launches; boot reconciliation moves runs whose session is gone back to Ready.

sources.title: Always-on host
sources.finding: Optional macOS login-item supervisor keeps a never-idle core running with the app closed and hands back to the app on launch; remote access is preview only.

sources.title: Harness stacks
sources.finding: Ordered stacks of same-harness accounts fail over to a backup when the primary hits a usage or rate limit, with cooldown rows per harness and model.

sources.title: Issue tasks
sources.finding: Tasks can be seeded from GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket issue threads via git-host APIs.

sources.title: Electrobun configuration
sources.locator: build targets (mac, linux icon entry at line ~95)
sources.finding: Electrobun app config; linux target entry exists but README says Linux and Windows are not built or tested.

sources.title: README board screenshot
sources.finding: Real board screenshot: New task form beside Backlog (5), Ready, Running (1: Website SEO on claude-code opus-4.7 plan), Blocked and Review columns; header shows Claude Code and Codex harness status dots and 6 tasks.

sources.finding: Latest release v1.2.1 published 2026-11-16 (commit 32aa7c3); v1.2.0 on 2026-11-10 and v1.1.1 on 2026-11-05.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
sources.finding: Matches are timers inside the app (fx auto-resume, OpenCode hub, model discovery, subagent handling) and the update check; no user-facing scheduler, cron or event trigger for tasks.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
sources.finding: Only incidental matches (GitLab, notifications); no users, roles, SSO or organizations.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.finding: Only incidental matches in test files and unrelated identifiers; README states no telemetry and lists the only network calls.

sources.title: Bounded search: spend and token limits
sources.finding: No budget or spend cap code; a usage meter reads plan quota and local token rollups.

sources.title: Bounded search: pricing and billing
sources.finding: No pricing or billing; README links GitHub Sponsors only.

sources.title: Bounded search: sandbox and containers
sources.finding: README documents headless container use only; agents get no sandbox beyond what each CLI provides: src/bun/agents.ts selects Codex sandbox modes (read-only, workspace-write, escalating auto runs to danger-full-access when a writable root is outside the cwd) and Cursor ACP passes neither --trust nor --sandbox.
